reason: Bit-equal candidate lookup tables in the resized uint8 domain; reference exposure and dark-level QC exclude the short-exposure plateau observed in the preliminary sweep; timing separates camera wait from processing latency.

candidate_route.input: RGB uint8, cv2 INTER_LINEAR 256x256, exactly resize_input before float32 /255
candidate_route.table: For each uint8 v, float32(v)/255.0 -> exact original apply_gamma_correction(gamma=1/g): float32 input copy, np.power(input,1.0/(1/g)), clip 0..1, float32, caller clip 0..1 and float32, rgb8 clip(image*255,0,255).astype(uint8). cv2.LUT on RGB uint8 input.
candidate_route.gamma_scalar_types: Nine grid values remain numpy.float64, so float64 power under installed NumPy 2.4.4; separate default 2/3 remains Python float, preserving original float32 power behavior. Never replace reciprocal expression by g.
candidate_route.features_and_models: Same gray8, entropy, gray.astype(float) std/255, Laplacian CV_64F variance/255**2 and A bit-equal batched inference; original tie/top1 rules unchanged.
candidate_route.scientific_metrics: Keep exact float32 gamma candidates offline in NPZ and score LPIPS/PSNR/SSIM/CLIP-IQA+/NIQE on those float32 candidates. Table images only supply classical features and NR scores.

equality.old_dry_run: All 20 inputs x (9 numpy.float64 grid + Python default) = 200 candidates from dry_run_001
equality.require: Exact dtype, shape and bytes for RGB8, 3 features, brightness, NR-free and NR-mono; all four selected gammas identical. Sequential previous-gamma state per selector, reset at each dataset start; additionally independent-frame previous=2/3 checks.
equality.failure: Stop table activation on first mismatch, preserve diagnostic, no table-path timings; float path remains usable.
equality.startup_selftest: Every live session: all 256 input values arranged in a tiled RGB test frame plus 3 random 256x256 uint8 frames (seed 20261024), all 10 gammas; exact same comparisons. Require valid full-validation certificate bound to implementation hashes. Failure aborts live session.
equality.new_dry_run: Also verify all 200 candidates in dry_run_2 against original float route; never scientific analysis.

E0.no_valid_E0: Reject attempt; adjust diffuse illumination or scene outside capture, keep camera fixed, then retry. Never relax threshold or accept plateau.

QC.stop_luminance: At native resolution, each raw frame gray8 = cv2.cvtColor(BGR uint8,COLOR_BGR2GRAY), mean(gray8)/255. Reference baseline is mean of 16 beginning raw-frame luminances; stop is mean of its five raw-frame luminances.
QC.boundary: <= 0.90 * previous and >= 0.084 inclusive, no tolerance adjustment
QC.failure: Entire scene excluded from analysis and publishable data; reasons retained; dry_run remains excluded regardless of QC.

timing.processing: resize + 9 candidate features / batched NR-free prediction + selection + full-resolution precomputed LUT application; excludes capture/display/logging
timing.camera_interval: Host capture-completion timestamps: capture-only acquisition baseline independently per exposure, plus observed live capture-completion intervals. Host delivery interval, not sensor timestamp or photon-to-screen latency.
timing.claim: Report processing median and p95 against capture-only camera median separately per exposure; only claim measured processing keeps up when processing p95 < camera baseline median. FPS from capture-only delivery intervals; do not infer camera fps from requested FPS.
timing.resource_idle_check: Inspect workload state before timing. Do not time while a separate model-evaluation worker is active or a Python process cannot be inspected. A confirmed pause with no active worker permits a stale running-state record. Do not interrupt other workloads.

dry_run.repeat_rule: Exactly one new dry-run attempt. QC failure is reported without tuning/repeating for a pass; timing and equality may still be assessed as engineering tests.

unchanged: Published models, fixed gamma, 9-candidate set, resolution, primary/secondary hypotheses, bootstrap, tie and top-1 rules.
